meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 在回应前会先想起之前聊过的相关内容；每轮对话结束后又自动把新学到的信息存入长期记忆。即使容器重启，这些记忆也不会丢。
howto.when: 用在默认 Claude Code 的容器里：每次 Claude 要回复前，以及每轮对话结束后，都会自动执行记忆步骤各一次。如果容器改用 opencode 等其他驱动，则不会生效。

say.text: 我们上次提到给数据库加索引，结论是什么？
say.note: 说到旧事，新会话会调出上次存储的相关记忆。

say.text: 记住我的服务器每月一号都要重启。
say.note: 这句话会被存入记忆库，下次可能自动记起。

say.text: 记下刚才的部署步骤，下次会话时提醒我。
say.note: 本回合新信息会被写入记忆库，供后续调用。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude recalls stored context relevant to the current conversation before each response, and writes new insights to memory after every turn. This memory survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Active in containers running the default Claude provider (claude-code): the memory step happens before each reply and after every turn. If a group uses another provider, e.g. opencode, this memory hook is not triggered.

say_en.text: Last time we talked about adding a DB index — what was our conclusion?
say_en.note: The new session will recall that part of history.

say_en.text: Remember that my server reboots on the first day of every month.
say_en.note: This statement is stored into memory after your turn.

say_en.text: Note down the deploy steps from just now; remind me next session.
say_en.note: This turn's information gets saved and can be surfaced later.
